adjustedPrice.invalidWhen: any adjusted O_t, H_t, L_t, or C_t <= 0
adjustedPrice.archiveDisposition: retain the source row and mark it invalid
adjustedPrice.analysisDisposition: exclude the row and every dependent feature, score, threshold pair, calibrator pair, and outcome

zeroVolume.archiveDisposition: V_t=0 is a valid archived observation
zeroVolume.signalSessionDisposition: when V_t=0, every feature whose formula depends on V_t is unavailable
zeroVolume.historicalWindowDisposition: historical zero-volume observations remain actual sessions and contribute zero weight; a zero denominator makes the dependent feature unavailable

anchored.blockRule: blocks are consecutive, non-overlapping, contain exactly 120 actual sessions, and are each an exact test fold

TSLA.overlappingDateRule: never add sensitivity observations to primary or global event counts

NVDA.blockContract: same three ordinal blocks as TSLA primary

referenceWindow.missingValueRule: do not replace a missing value and do not extend farther into the past to replenish it

percentile.externalApplication: recompute from each symbol's own prior actual sessions using this unchanged algorithm

candidateScoring.informationSet: daily adjusted OHLCV available through close_t only

probabilityCalibration.purpose: convert an ordinal risk score into an out-of-sample event probability without treating score/100 as a probability

trainingPairs.source: the current fold's same-symbol past training partition only

quantileBins.edgeAlgorithm: for q=k/5, use the score at one-based order statistic ceil(q*n) after ascending score sort
quantileBins.tiedScoreRule: equal scores are never split across bins
quantileBins.duplicateEdgeRule: collapse equal adjacent quantile edges before assigning bins
quantileBins.emptyBinRule: drop empty bins after edge collapse

binProbability.successCount: unweighted count of label=1 in bin j
binProbability.sampleCount: unweighted count of valid training pairs in bin j

monotonicFit.violationRule: while a left fitted value is greater than its right neighbor, replace the adjacent violating blocks by their n-weighted mean and repeat until no violation remains

testApplication.probabilitySource: fitted monotonic bin value from the corresponding training-only calibrator

replicationAndHoldout.finalFitTrigger: after TSLA candidate selection is complete

finalFitSource.requiredPair: finite raw candidate score and eligible observed binary outcome label

trainBaseRateComparator.trainingLabels: all finite binary labels in the fold training partition; candidate score availability is not required
trainBaseRateComparator.application: constant probability for every observation in that fold test partition

replicationAndHoldout.finalFitSource: all eligible observed TSLA primary-anchor labels at session ordinals 0..359 for the outcome and horizon

foldFit.refitPolicy: fit once per fold from that fold's frozen past training partition

threshold.fitSource: the current fold's same-symbol past training partition only
threshold.validPairRequirement: finite raw score and eligible observed binary outcome label
threshold.foldUpdatePolicy: fit once per fold; no within-fold update

externalFinalFit.source: all valid TSLA primary-anchor session-ordinal 0..359 labeled raw scores

walkForward.testFoldRule: each listed block is an exact 120-session test fold

training.source: all actual sessions for the same symbol
training.preAnchorOrdinalRule: the actual session immediately before anchor ordinal 0 is -1, followed backward by -2, -3, and so on

signal.thresholdCrossing: score_t >= q80 and (the previous eligible score < q80 or the previous score is unavailable)
signal.reentryRule: the next episode requires a new qualifying upward crossing strictly after t+h

groundTruth.originSet: all eligible evaluation-session origins whose candidate-independent outcome label is success
groundTruth.targetDate: actual session date of the origin's first target-barrier passage
groundTruth.targetDateRule: the episode keeps the earliest retained origin's first target-barrier passage date; suppressed origins never revise it

leadTime.matchRule: match an alert to the earliest same-symbol, same-outcome, same-horizon ground-truth targetDate on or after alertDate and no later than alertDate+h
leadTime.tieBreak: earliest targetDate, then earliest origin ordinal

marketEventClustering.clusterRule: same-direction unassigned events belong to a cluster only when their targetDate is within plus or minus one calendar day of that cluster's earliest anchor targetDate
marketEventClustering.ordering: ascending targetDate, then Unicode code-point ascending symbol
marketEventClustering.algorithm: greedy non-chaining: start a cluster from the earliest unassigned event and include unassigned same-direction events whose targetDate differs from that anchor date by at most one calendar day
marketEventClustering.chainRule: do not extend a cluster through an event that is within one day only of a non-anchor member

trialApplicability.missingOutcomeSpecificCandidateSet: use candidate.applicableHorizons as the candidate outcome-specific set
trialApplicability.missingOutcomeDefinitionSet: use protocol.horizons as the outcome-definition set
trialApplicability.outcomeMembershipRule: an outcome is considered only when its id is present in candidate.outcomeDefinitionIds
trialApplicability.candidateTrialRule: candidate@h is applicable when at least one declared outcome has h in its effectiveHorizons

minimumEvents.countBasis: raw non-overlapping observed candidate signal episodes before cross-symbol cluster weights
minimumEvents.adjustmentFamilyDisposition: exclude unavailable p-values from BH and retain fixed Holm hypotheses as insufficient and never significant

evaluationStage.anchored: the three exact fold test partitions recombined after fold-specific out-of-fold prediction

bootstrap.blockLengthPolicy: run and report every block length separately

foldResampling.procedure: resample each fold separately, then concatenate fold resamples in chronological fold order
foldResampling.observationOrder: chronological paired observations within each fold
foldResampling.observationUnit: all chronological valid paired daily probability-label loss observations; signal-episode cooldown does not thin Brier, PR-AUC, or MCC loss pairs

perFoldAlgorithm.startIndexFormula: floor(u * (n-effectiveBlockLength+1)) for PRNG uniform u in [0,1)
perFoldAlgorithm.shortFoldRule: when 0<n<L use one full-length non-circular block with effectiveBlockLength=n; when n=0 the replicate and hypothesis are unavailable

conservativeCombination.lowerBound: minimum of the L=5,10,20 lower bounds
conservativeCombination.upperBound: maximum of the L=5,10,20 upper bounds
conservativeCombination.pValue: maximum of the L=5,10,20 one-sided p-values

candidateVersusBaseRate.comparison: candidate probability versus that fold's training-only Jeffreys base-rate probability

complexFormulaAdoption.appliesTo: candidate kind is composite or repaired
complexFormulaAdoption.comparator: the preregistered formula baseline with the lowest paired out-of-fold Brier score in the same family, outcome, and horizon
complexFormulaAdoption.criterion: conservative paired bootstrap 95% confidence interval lower bound > 0

reliefConfirmedComparator.role: fixed documented formula comparator for relief.persistenceGated

ordering.candidates: zero-based Unicode code-point ascending candidateId order
ordering.outcomes: zero-based Unicode code-point ascending outcomeDefinitionId order

randomness.streamPolicy: initialize one PRNG stream per candidate, outcome, horizon, block length, fold, and purpose; consume it sequentially across repetitions and block draws

dateBlockCircularShift.operation: circularly shift the ordered within-fold binary label vector while leaving dates, scores, probabilities, and fold membership fixed
dateBlockCircularShift.nDefinition: number of chronological valid paired observations in that symbol and fold
dateBlockCircularShift.offsetSampling: 2000 draws with replacement using protocol.randomness purposeOrdinal=2 and blockLength=0
dateBlockCircularShift.offsetIndexFormula: floor(u * numberOfAllowedOffsets) for PRNG uniform u in [0,1)
dateBlockCircularShift.shiftDirection: left circular shift by the sampled offset
dateBlockCircularShift.comparison: report observed BrierDifference beside the placebo distribution and its empirical rank

matchedNonEventNegativeControl.reason: no pre-data exact volatility-and-trend matching algorithm is registered
matchedNonEventNegativeControl.claimLimit: do not claim performance against a matched non-event negative control

hypothesisRegistry.generationRule: expand the intersection of protocol horizons, candidate applicableHorizons, candidate outcomeApplicableHorizons, and outcome applicableHorizons
hypothesisRegistry.canonicalization: recursive object-key code-point sort, preserve array order, compact JSON UTF-8, SHA-256

reliefState.informationSet: fixed at close_t before any future outcome observation

reliefFirstRebound.firstPassageRule: upper target before lower opposite; common same-session dual-hit and right-censoring rules apply

confirmation.lowCondition: L_s >= episodeLow_t for each confirmation session s
confirmation.closeCondition: C_s >= midpointRecovery_t for each confirmation session s
confirmation.successRule: base upper barrier is first hit at tau and both confirmation sessions satisfy both conditions
confirmation.failureRule: base rebound fails, or either confirmation session violates either condition

competingTerminalEvent.formula: the first completion of two consecutive sessions with L_s >= episodeLow_t and C_s >= midpointRecovery_t

fakeRelief.firstPassageRule: success when episodeLow_break occurs before relief_confirmation; failure when relief_confirmation occurs first or no episodeLow_break occurs through tau+3
fakeRelief.sameSessionRule: episodeLow_break takes precedence because L_s < episodeLow_t makes relief_confirmation false

common.informationSet: adjusted daily OHLCV through close_t only; no t+1 or later value is permitted
common.sessionIndexing: all endpoints refer to ordered actual trading-session observations and are inclusive; no calendar-day interpolation
common.rollingValidity: every observation required by a window must be finite and valid; partial-window calculation and synthetic filling are prohibited
common.medianDefinition: for an even sample count, median is the arithmetic mean of the two central values after ascending sort

atr14.minimumPeriods: 14 valid true-range observations requiring OHLC_{t-13:t} and C_{t-14}

momentumAndReturnImpulse5.minimumPeriods: 6 valid close observations from t-5 through t

drawdown3.minimumPeriods: 4 valid close observations from t-3 through t

runup20.minimumPeriods: 21 valid close observations from t-20 through t

profitTakingEligibility20.minimumPeriods: 21 valid close observations plus a valid ATR14_t

volumeReference20.minimumPeriods: 20 valid reference volumes plus current volume

vwapPersistence5.minimumPeriods: 5 valid TP_j, V_j, and VWAP20_j observations

percentileTransform.endpoints: up to 252 sessions strictly before t

volumeZeroSemantics.observedZero: V_j=0 is a valid archived observation and remains an actual session
volumeZeroSemantics.signalSession: V_t=0 makes every feature whose formula depends on V_t unavailable
volumeZeroSemantics.historicalWeightedTerm: historical zero volume contributes zero numerator and denominator weight
volumeZeroSemantics.zeroMedian: median(V_reference)=0 makes the volume-ratio feature unavailable
volumeZeroSemantics.zeroSum: sum(V_window)=0 makes every dependent volume-weighted ratio or VWAP unavailable

common.atrZero: ATR14_t=0 makes every ATR-dependent feature unavailable
common.invalidAdjustedPrice: any adjusted O,H,L,C <= 0 marks the archive row invalid and makes every dependent feature unavailable

trueRange.formula: max(H_t - L_t, abs(H_t - C_{t-1}), abs(L_t - C_{t-1}))

rangeChase.formula: 0.6 * clip((C_t - lowPrev20_t) / (highPrev20_t - lowPrev20_t), 0, 1) + 0.4 * clip((C_t - highPrev20_t) / ATR14_t, 0, 1)

selection.primaryOutcomeRole: overall focal outcome; the complete fixed Holm confirmatory list is protocol.significance.primaryConclusions.hypotheses and does not replace per-trial candidate selection
selection.candidateSelectionScope: apply primaryMetric separately within every applicable family, outcomeDefinitionId, and horizon on TSLA

primaryMetric.evaluationData: TSLA primary-anchor three-block out-of-fold predictions only

baselineDifferenceMetric.comparisonSample: paired test observations with a valid binary label and valid probabilities from both candidate and comparator
baselineDifferenceMetric.comparatorSet: the fold-training Jeffreys base-rate comparator and every preregistered formula baseline in the same family, outcome, and horizon
baselineDifferenceMetric.strongestComparator: the comparator with the lowest out-of-sample BrierScore
baselineDifferenceMetric.winCriterion: for complex-formula adoption, the conservative paired moving-block bootstrap 95% confidence interval lower bound is > 0 against the best preregistered formula baseline

selection.sequenceLock: TSLA primary-anchor selection is final; sensitivity, NVDA, MU, and 000660 results cannot change candidates, definitions, weights, calibrators, base rates, or q80 thresholds

baselineComparator.fomo: lowest-Brier candidate whose kind is baseline within the same outcome and horizon
baselineComparator.panic: lowest-Brier candidate whose kind is baseline within the same outcome and horizon
baselineComparator.potentialPtp: lowest-Brier candidate whose kind is baseline within the same outcome and horizon
baselineComparator.relief: relief.originalProxy for shared applicable outcomes and horizons

baselineWinRequirement.rule: a candidate whose kind is composite or repaired is retained only when baselineDifferenceMetric.winCriterion is met against its fixed family comparator
baselineWinRequirement.proxyDisposition: a proxy candidate is a preregistered comparator and is not subject to the complex-formula adoption gate

selection.uncertaintySet: two candidates are statistically indistinguishable when the paired moving-block bootstrap 95% confidence interval for their BrierScore difference includes 0

candidateSelectionPerformance.source: all test predictions from the three exact 120-session anchored folds
candidateSelectionPerformance.foldAlgorithm: each fold may refit on its expanding past-only training partition
